title: Descend a finite hypercover skeleton and extend at a stage
statement: Let D be a small cofiltered inverse system of qcqs schemes with affine transitions and qcqs limit c. For any finite split étale hypercover U of c.pt and r≥0, some stage admits a full finite split étale hypercover V whose pullback to c.pt has r-truncation isomorphic to the r-truncation of U.

proof.text: Take the genuine finite truncation of U. Finite hypercover descent gives a truncated finite split hypercover at some stage and a base-change isomorphism of its underlying finite over-scheme diagram. Extend the descended skeleton to a full hypercover at that stage. Whisker its truncation isomorphism by the forgetful and pullback functors and compose with the descent isomorphism. Full faithfulness of the étale forgetful functor lifts the components and their naturality to an isomorphism of truncated étale diagrams.

theorem exists_stage_hypercover_truncation
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) [CompactSpace c.pt] [QuasiSeparatedSpace c.pt] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (r : ℕ) (U : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover c.pt) :
    ∃ (i : Iᵒᵖ) (V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover (D.obj i)),
      Nonempty ((SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj
        (V.baseChange (show c.pt ⟶ D.obj i from c.π.app i)).simplicial ≅
        (SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj U.simplicial)
